clauses.title: The adversarial gate names every same-class rigor gap in one result
clauses.section: #### Sol-only adversarial invariant payload block (AC-ADVERSARIAL-payload, CL-D29)
requires: When a finding rejects the rigor of a check — a presence, substring, or subsequence test where the criterion calls for an exact comparison — name every check of the same class across the target in that one result, so the correction is made once (CL-D66).

clauses.title: The exact-autofix writer writes checks against declared lists exactly the first time
requires: A check the writer adds or corrects against a declared list or block is written as a complete parse of the surface and an exact ordered comparison with the derived expectation, never as a presence, substring, or subsequence test (CL-D66).

clauses.title: The CL-D66 record states the placement, the declined alternatives, and the boundary
clauses.section: ## CL-D66 — Same-class rigor gaps are named once and written exactly the first time
requires: a deterministic lint over test files, which classifies open-world test code and is declined
a presence check where presence is the criterion is not a finding
verdict vocabulary, gate authority, the CL-D30 caps, and the CL-D63 fence-grammar bound are unchanged
re-invoke the gate against the named component after each finding, which costs a counted gate and a full review and is declined
no verdict rule, no severity, no anchoring class, and no round budget
attempts every other counterexample class against that same component

clauses.title: The CL-D66 fixtures pin both sentences and the record
requires: the adversarial gate names every same-class rigor gap in one result and the writer writes exact checks
CL-D66 records the placement, the declined alternatives, and the boundary

clauses.title: The adversarial gate exhausts a component it has broken
clauses.section: #### Sol-only adversarial invariant payload block (AC-ADVERSARIAL-payload, CL-D29)
requires: When a finding exhibits a counterexample against a component, attempt every other counterexample class against that same component — its other inputs, encodings, syntax forms, and boundaries — and report all that succeed in that one result, so the component is corrected once.

clauses.title: The component sweep is pinned by its own test
requires: Issue #126 the adversarial gate exhausts a broken component before it returns
Issue #126 CL-D66 records the component sweep, its declined alternatives, and its boundary
